## Standards

No documented standards violations found in `fd412468...c364410d`. The implementation follows the React/accessibility guidance: hooks remain top-level in `CaptureForm` (`src/app/index.tsx:109-116`), completion is extracted as a top-level component (`src/app/index.tsx:302`), controls are semantic buttons with `aria-pressed` and a labelled fieldset (`src/app/index.tsx:371-398`), and async operations use `try/catch/finally` with structured error handling (`src/app/index.tsx:315-347`; `src/lib/sightings.server.ts:42-67`). Tests use async/await and assertions inside `it()` blocks.

`bun run lint` passes; `git diff --check` is clean. `bun run check` is unavailable because `package.json` defines `lint`, not `check`.

Fowler baseline judgment calls: no convincing Mysterious Name, Duplicated Code, Feature Envy, Data Clumps, Primitive Obsession, Repeated Switches, Shotgun Surgery, Speculative Generality, Message Chains, Middle Man, or Refused Bequest. A possible mild Divergent Change exists because `src/app/index.tsx` now owns both Capture and completion UI, but completion is already isolated into `SightingCompletion`; not actionable. No meaningful smell warrants a finding.

VERDICT: READY
